name: Moon Base science delivery (Astrobotic, second of two)

surface_window.note: The landing date is known only as 'late 2028', so there is no single window: compare months on the calendar instead.

outcome_note: Awarded June 30, 2026 as one of four new CLPS missions to land in late 2028, using an updated version of an already-flown lander design.

payloads.name: Stereo Camera for Lunar Plume Surface Studies
payloads.purpose: Stereo cameras producing a 3D view of the engine plume's effect on lunar dust.

payloads.name: Laser Retroreflector Array
payloads.purpose: Passive retroreflectors building a network of permanent location markers.

payloads.name: Linear Energy Transfer Spectrometer
payloads.purpose: Radiation monitor measuring the energy and type of incoming space radiation.

sources.title: NASA Awards More Moon Base Science, Previews New Opportunities (RELEASE 26-053, Jun 30, 2026)

notes: NASA did not publish a task order name, lander, or destination for this award in the release.
Mission facts are compiled by hand from NASA pages, LROC images and the IAU Gazetteer; every record carries its sources, last read 2026-09-23.
1 of 1 missions have fields no source confirms; they are listed as unconfirmed, never filled in.
Numbers are Sun and Earth geometry at the target over the mission's surface window, not what any lander measured.
